# Human Origin Project

> > Exploring human origins, evolution, consciousness, and ancient wisdom through science, astronomy, and indigenous knowledge.

The Human Origin Project examines humanity's past through interdisciplinary lenses including evolutionary biology, archaeoastronomy, ancient civilizations, and consciousness studies. Founded by Steven and Stefan, the site features educational articles, meditation guides, and podcast interviews with experts like Carlotta Giangualano on topics ranging from Darwin's theory to Mayan mythology.

## Key Topics

- Human evolution and Darwin's theory
- Natural selection and evolutionary biology
- Ancient astronomy and archaeoastronomy
- Consciousness evolution
- Mayan mythology and indigenous knowledge
- Meditation and mindfulness practices
- Ancient civilizations (Sumer, Egypt, Maya)
- Lunar cycles and celestial events
- Younger Dryas and megafauna extinction
- Pineal gland and neuroscience
- Halloween origins and Taurid meteor showers
- Gregor Mendel and genetics
- Vedic astronomy and Hindu calendar
- Great Sphinx of Giza mysteries
- Precession of the equinoxes

## Human Evolution and Biology

- [Darwin's Theory of Evolution in 5 Easy Points You'll Understand](https://humanoriginproject.com/darwins-theory-evolution): Explains Darwin's theory from Origin of Species in 5 easy principles
- [New Human Evidence of Evolution & Darwin's Theory [In 5 Easy Points]](https://humanoriginproject.com/new-human-evidence-of-evolution-darwins-theory): Modern evidence reshaping Darwin's natural selection theory in 5 points
- [Find Out How the Evolution of Consciousness Happened](https://humanoriginproject.com/evolution-consciousness): Traces consciousness evolution from Cambrian Explosion to humans
- [Discover What is a Chromosome and its Specific Function](https://humanoriginproject.com/chromosome-function): Explains chromosomes, DNA, and Mendel's inheritance laws simply
- [The Entire Function of the Pineal Gland | Human Brain Parts](https://humanoriginproject.com/function-of-the-pineal-gland): Explores pineal gland's role in melatonin, sleep, and endocrine system

## Meditation and Mindfulness Practices

- [What is Mindfulness? (A Quick 6-Step Mindfulness Meditation)](https://humanoriginproject.com/what-is-mindfulness-quick-6-step-mindfulness-meditation): 6-step beginner's guide to mindfulness meditation practice
- [The 6-Step Science-Backed Healing Meditation Technique](https://humanoriginproject.com/healing-meditation): Harvard-backed 6-step healing meditation from Vedic tradition

## Ancient Civilizations and Archaeology

- [Oldest Civilization in the World: 7 Strong Possible Cases](https://humanoriginproject.com/oldest-civilization-world): Examines 7 candidates for world's oldest civilization including Sumer
- [Riddle of the Sphinx of Giza | When Was it Built? Who Built it and Why?](https://humanoriginproject.com/riddle-of-the-sphinx-who-built-it-and-why): Explores Great Sphinx of Giza dating and construction mysteries

## Ancient Astronomy and Celestial Cycles

- [Meaning of Halloween: The Spooky Truth According to Astronomy](https://humanoriginproject.com/meaning-halloween-according-astronomy): Links Day of the Dead and Halloween to Taurid meteor stream astronomy
- [The New Moon Lunar Cycle | What is a New Moon?](https://humanoriginproject.com/the-new-moon-lunar-cycle-what-is-a-new-moon): Explains new moon phases and lunar calendar tracking basics
- [2019 Full Moons & Understanding the Full Moon Cycle](https://humanoriginproject.com/2019-full-moons-understanding-the-full-moon-cycle): 2019 full moon calendar and lunar cycle explanation with NASA data
- [The 2019 Hindu Calendar, Religious Festivals, and Zodiac](https://humanoriginproject.com/the-2019-hindu-calendar-religious-festivals-and-zodiac): Explores Hindu Calendar's Vedic astronomy and religious festivals
